Here is a recap of what happened in the search forums today, through the eyes of the Search Engine Roundtable and other search forums on the web.
We may be seeing another unconfirmed Google Search ranking update hit over the past day or so. Google has updated its UGC spam policy in an important way. Google's John Mueller has downplayed the importance of a fresh indexing report. There is a lot of confusion on what is and what is not a Local Service Ad. Google is testing placing dotted underlined links in the sponsored results ad descriptions. Google is testing placing dotted underlined links in the sponsored results ad descriptions. Google Ads said it will update its Child Sexual Abuse and Exploitation (CSAE) ads policy this coming January.
Search Engine Roundtable Stories:
-
Unconfirmed Google Search Ranking Update: Volatility & Chatter Spike
I know I just reported on an unconfirmed Google Search ranking update from this past Saturday, October 24th. But I am now seeing a larger spike in volatility, along with an increase in SEO community chatter around another unconfirmed update over the past 24 hours. -
Google Warns Tools On User-Generated Spam Guidance & More
Google has updated its Prevent user-generated spam on your site and platform help document to specify "tools that let users publish shared pages, generated content, or web apps." The update explicitly includes platforms and tools that let users create shared pages, generated content, and web apps. -
Google Downplays The Importance Of Fresh Index Reporting
Google's John Mueller kind of downplayed the importance of the freshness of the Google Search Console page indexing report. He said on Reddit, in response to my coverage of the report's recent slowness, that "it can feel like it's important to focus on it, but honestly, save your energy." -
Advertisers Can't Figure Out If An Ad Is A Google Local Service Ad Or Not
Google advertisers are struggling to agree on whether a specific local ad unit in Google Search is a Local Service Ad or another type of local Google ad. -
Google Ads Tests Dotted Underlined Links In Sponsored Results
Google is testing placing dotted underlined links in the sponsored results ad descriptions. When you click on them, you go to the ad destination's URL, like you would if you clicked on the title of the ad. -
Google Ads To Update Child Sexual Abuse and Exploitation (CSAE) Policy
Google Ads said it will update its Child Sexual Abuse and Exploitation (CSAE) ads policy this coming January. Google said this is being done as part of a "redesign of the policy, and to improve protections, clarity and transparency." -
Google Montreal Library Lounge
Here is a photo of the library at the Google office in Montreal, Canada. What I don't understand is that green button and QR code, what is that about? I can't read it.
